about: Lists a team's notes print from a paid lookup (Stathead), kept current here by counting forward from the day they were read. rows: [player, count through `through`].
situations_about: Game states with a record someone has looked up over many seasons (a paid lookup), shown in NBA Live when a live game enters one. `text` is the record as printed on `asOf`; it is not counted forward (the play-by-play kept here starts in 2026-27). when: ot (an overtime period), period, maxLeft (seconds left in the period), minDown (the margin), roadMin / homeMax (points). playoffs: only in the playoffs (not switched on yet).

situations.text: teams down 10+ in overtime are 1-180 over the last 29 seasons (the one: Minnesota, from 13 down, 3/25/26)
one game of 37,964 since 1996-97 has had the road team score 100 before the home team had 50 (Knicks at Hawks, 4/30/26)
teams leading by 6+ in the last 30 seconds of regulation in the playoffs are 1713-2 over the last 29 years (the two: the 2024 Knicks and the 2026 Rockets lost)
teams down 14+ in the final 2:50 of regulation in the playoffs are 1-970 over the last 27 postseasons
